item.name: Routing
item.value: React Router v6 - BrowserRouter, nested routes via Outlet

file.purpose: React root mount. Renders App into #root. No providers here.
Root component. ThemeProvider > BrowserRouter > Routes. Initialises authStore + socket on mount.
Path alias '@' = src/. No dev proxy. Direct API calls to VITE_API_URL.

roles.role: Platform-level access. Manage all organizations, global users, system logs, and platform-wide settings (limits, tiers). Restricted from regular chat.
Organization-level admin. Full access within own org. Manage projects, team, tickets, and organization settings (Company Profile).
Own team management. Create projects/tasks, see assigned team members. Cannot manage org settings.
Standard user. Update own task progress/status. Read-only for assigned projects.
External access. Submit tickets, view own projects. No chat access.

routing.note: All protected routes are children of Layout route at '/'. No token → redirected to /login. RoleBasedRedirect (src/components/RoleBasedRedirect.jsx) redirects after login by role. All roles → /dashboard (but layout sidebar items vary by role).

route.note: Creates org + ADMIN user. Uses premium Select components.
Requires token. Forced password change flow.

stores.store:
Persisted to localStorage key 'auth-storage' (JSON: { state: { token, user } }).
token: string|null — JWT. Null = unauthenticated. user: { id, name, email, role, organizationId, isApproved, mustChangePassword, avatar } | null
login(token, user) — Set state + save to localStorage logout() — Clear state + remove from localStorage updateUser(user) — Update user in memory only (no localStorage) initialize() — Read from localStorage on app load (called in App.jsx useEffect)

Manages Socket.IO connection and per-room unread message counts.
socket: object|null userId: string|null isConnected: boolean unreadCounts: { [roomId: string]: number } — 'global' = global chat room totalUnread: number — Sum of all unreadCounts activeRoomId: string|null — Currently open room (suppresses unread increments)
initSocket(userId) — Create Socket.IO conn to VITE_API_URL. Called in App.jsx. joinRoom(roomId) — Emit 'join-room' event rejoinRooms(apiInstance) — Re-join global + all project rooms. Fetches from /api/chat/rooms. setActiveRoom(roomId) — Track current chat room, clear its unread count clearUnread(roomId) — Set unread count for a room to 0 fetchInitialUnread() — On connect, fetch initial unread from /api/chat/rooms disconnectSocket() — Disconnect on logout
LISTENS: 'message-notification' — Global broadcast. Increment unread if sender≠me AND room≠activeRoom. LISTENS: 'new-message' — Received when IN the room. Clear unread for that room. EMITS: 'join-room' — payload: roomId (string) EMITS: 'send-message' — payload: { content, userId, projectId } (projectId=null for global)
Simple store for the page header (shown in Layout.jsx top bar). title: string, subtitle: string setHeader(title, subtitle) — Pages call this in useEffect on mount.

frontend_architecture.layout:
Shell for all authenticated pages: sidebar (desktop), bottom nav (mobile), top header bar (title/subtitle from headerStore), React Router Outlet.
SIDEBAR ITEMS (role-based visibility): Dashboard → /dashboard — ALL roles Performance → /performance — ADMIN, MANAGER, MEMBER Projects → /projects — ALL roles Kanban → /kanban — ADMIN, MANAGER, MEMBER Task Board → /task-board — ADMIN, MANAGER, MEMBER Tasks → /tasks — ALL roles Team → /team — ADMIN, MANAGER Timesheets → /timesheets — ALL roles Chat → /chat — ADMIN, MANAGER, MEMBER (not CLIENT) Tickets → /tickets — ALL roles Settings → /settings — ALL roles (includes Appearance) Organization → /organization — ADMIN only (Accessible via Account menu)

pages.page: APIs: GET /projects, GET /tasks/my-tasks, GET /dashboard Features: Stats cards, recent projects list, recent tasks list, charts (recharts).
APIs: GET /performance/metrics, GET /projects (for dropdown) Features: Renders charts for project health, story point burnup, and team velocity using Recharts.

APIs: GET /projects params: page,limit,search,status,category,managerId,clientId GET /users — for filter dropdowns (managers + clients) POST /projects — create project PUT /projects/:id — edit project DELETE /projects/:id — delete project
State: projects, loading, users, searchTerm, debouncedSearch(400ms), statusFilter, managerFilter, clientFilter, page, pageSize, totalPages, totalItems, showFiltersMobile
IMPORTANT: ALL filtering is server-side. 'filteredProjects' = raw 'projects' state. Manager→Client dependency: clientOptions derived from users where user.managers array contains the selected managerFilter ID. Components used: SearchableSelect (for manager/client filters), TablePagination, ProjectOverview (in dialog), ConfirmDialog.

APIs: GET /projects/:id POST /projects/:id/members DELETE /projects/:id/members/:userId POST /tasks PUT /tasks/:id DELETE /tasks/:id Features: Phase management, task list per phase, team member list, project settings panel, budget tracking progress bar, and **Worklogs tab** for granular task-level time tracking.

APIs: GET /tasks params: page,limit,status,projectId,managerId,clientId,priority,type,search GET /projects — for project filter dropdown GET /users — for manager/client filter dropdowns POST /tasks PUT /tasks/:id DELETE /tasks/:id
State: tasks, loading, filter(status), projectFilter, managerFilter, clientFilter, priorityFilter, typeFilter, searchTerm, debouncedSearch(400ms), page, pageSize, totalPages, totalItems, users, projects, showFiltersMobile
ALL filtering is server-side. Manager→Client dependent dropdown same as ProjectsList. Components: CreateTaskForm (for create/edit dialog), ConfirmDialog, TablePagination.
Displays tasks with Project, Assignee, Status, Type, and Priority badges.
Filter by Project, Manager, Priority, Type, and Status (All, To Do, In Progress, etc.).

Shows project picker first, then task kanban by STATUS (5 columns). APIs: GET /projects params: search, managerId — project picker GET /tasks params: projectId — all tasks for selected project (no pagination) PATCH /tasks/:id/status — drag-and-drop status update Columns: TODO | IN_PROGRESS | IN_REVIEW | COMPLETED | BLOCKED

Phase-based kanban for a single selected project. APIs: GET /projects — project picker GET /projects/:id — load phases + tasks PATCH /tasks/:id/status — drag-and-drop Sub-components: src/components/kanban/KanbanBoard.jsx, KanbanColumn.jsx, KanbanCard.jsx

APIs: GET /users params: page,limit,search,roleFilter,pending PUT /users/:id — edit role/name/managerId DELETE /users/:id PUT /users/:id/approve — ADMIN only GET /users/:id/progress POST /auth/invite Features: Role tabs (All/Managers/Members/Clients/Pending), invite form, edit/delete dialogs, member progress charts.

APIs: GET /organizations PUT /organizations — update name, logo, theme color PATCH /users/profile — update own name, avatar (base64) Features: Profile editing, org branding, theme color picker, dark/light mode toggle.

APIs: GET /timesheets params: page,limit,userId,projectId,status,dateFrom,dateTo POST /timesheets PUT /timesheets/:id DELETE /timesheets/:id PATCH /timesheets/:id/status — approve/reject (ADMIN/MANAGER only)

APIs: GET /chat/rooms, GET /chat/messages params: roomId,limit,before Socket: emits 'send-message', listens 'new-message' Sub-component: src/components/Chat.jsx (main UI) Not accessible to CLIENT role.
APIs: GET /tickets params: page,limit,status,priority Note: CLIENT role sees only own tickets. ADMIN/MANAGER sees all.
APIs: POST /tickets
APIs: GET /tickets/:id, POST /tickets/:id/comments, PATCH /tickets/:id/status
APIs: GET /organizations/me, PUT /organizations/me Features: Admin can edit company profile, logo, industry, contact details.
Features: Platform-wide metrics (with rounded-3xl cards), system health monitoring (high-blur glassmorphism), latest system signups.
Features: Manage all organizations, edit plans, suspend/activate tenants. Uses premium DropdownMenu for all filtering and status updates.
Features: Global user management, echelons (roles) assignment. Features search and role-based filtering via DropdownMenu.

Features: Global infrastructure configuration (branding, quotas, security matrix). Includes **Appearance settings** (Light/Dark/System) for platform customization. Uses premium rounded-[2.5rem] cards and high-blur backgrounds.

frontend_architecture.ui_components:
Import pattern: import { X } from '@/components/ui/x';
button.jsx — Button. variants: default|destructive|outline|secondary|ghost|link input.jsx — Input label.jsx — Label select.jsx — Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue searchable-select.jsx — SearchableSelect props: options[{value,label}], value, onChange, placeholder, searchPlaceholder, disabled Single-value searchable dropdown built on Command component. multi-searchable-select.jsx — MultiSearchableSelect props: options[{value,label}], value(array), onChange, placeholder dialog.jsx — Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogTrigger alert-dialog.jsx — AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle, AlertDialogTrigger card.jsx — Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription table.jsx — Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow badge.jsx — Badge. variants: default|secondary|destructive|outline avatar.jsx — Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage tabs.jsx — Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger date-picker.jsx — DatePicker. props: date, setDate, placeholder, className toast.jsx — Toast components (use useToast hook to trigger, not directly) toaster.jsx — Toaster (rendered once in App.jsx) progress.jsx — Progress. props: value(0-100) dropdown-menu.jsx — DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuTrigger, etc. popover.jsx — Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger command.jsx — Command, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandInput, CommandItem, CommandList (used inside SearchableSelect) sheet.jsx — Sheet (slide-in panel). SheetContent, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetDescription, SheetTrigger scroll-area.jsx — ScrollArea separator.jsx — Separator calendar.jsx — Calendar (used inside DatePicker) charts.jsx — BarChart, PieChart, LineChart wrappers around recharts RichTextEditor.jsx — RichTextEditor. props: value, onChange, placeholder table-pagination.jsx — TablePagination (custom, described above) Modal.jsx — Simple Dialog wrapper with standard layout
frontend_architecture.utilities: cn(...classes) — Tailwind class merger (clsx + twMerge). Use for conditional Tailwind. formatDate(dateString) — Returns 'N/A' for null. Formats to locale date string. formatChatTimestamp(date) — 'Today, HH:MM AM/PM' | 'Yesterday, ...' | date string. formatCurrency(value) — $1.2M | $1.2K | $N | '$0' for null/NaN. priorityColors — object: LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH|URGENT → Tailwind Badge class string statusColors — object: TODO|IN_PROGRESS|IN_REVIEW|COMPLETED|BLOCKED → Badge class string
frontend_architecture.styling:
Primary color: CSS var --primary (configured per org in Settings, default blue) Dark mode: class-based via ThemeProvider. storageKey: 'taskflow-theme' Mobile utilities: mobile-reduce-spacing, mobile-reduce-grid, mobile-reduce-input, mobile-reduce-label (defined in src/index.css)
Premium Aesthetic (SuperAdmin Default): Main Cards: bg-white/40 dark:bg-black/40 border-border/40 backdrop-blur-3xl rounded-[2.5rem] shadow-2xl Metric Cards: rounded-3xl backdrop-blur-2xl shadow-xl Primary Buttons: h-14 rounded-2xl font-black uppercase tracking-[0.2em] shadow-lg shadow-primary/20 Inputs/Filters: h-14 rounded-2xl bg-white/50 dark:bg-black/50 border-border/40 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-primary/10 Dropdowns: bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-border/40 shadow-2xl rounded-2xl p-2 with orange (bg-orange-500) active state Inner Shadows: Applied to inputs/search bars via 'shadow-inner' for a high-fidelity embedded look.
Filter bar look: bg-secondary/40 border border-border/60 p-2 rounded-2xl (legacy) | Glassmorphic engine (new) Page layout: flex-1 flex flex-col h-full overflow-hidden (every page root) Badge fonts: class 'Montserrat font-bold' applied to status/priority badges Kanban Borders: Columns use `ring-2` with 60% opacity for high visibility. Cards use `ring-border/80` for distinct separation.

recent_updates.update: Integrated a high-fidelity glassmorphic `UpgradePlanModal` triggered when users attempt to exceed trial resource limits (e.g., max projects / max users). Maintains premium aesthetic guidelines inside `lib/utils` and Tailwind classes.
Fixed filtering logic inside `AuditFilters.jsx` to accurately display `INVITED` and `APPROVED` actions (from org member addition flow). Prevented SearchableSelect toggle deselection glitch.

Added platform-level **Appearance settings** (Light/Dark/System) to the Super Admin dashboard. Refactored the **Signup page** to use premium Shadcn `Select` components for a better UX. Removed redundant Organisation sidebar links; consolidated into the Account dropdown. Updated `SuperAdminLayout` for theme-aware dropdown visibility (bg-background/95).

Implemented a robust end-to-end feature restriction system. 1. **Backend**: `featureGate.js` blocks restricted API calls returning a 403. 2. **Frontend App**: `FeatureGuard` intercepts restricted pages and renders the new premium `RestrictedAccess.jsx` component instead of failing silently or redirecting to dashboard. 3. **Frontend Sidebar**: Hiding nav items. Also implemented a 5-minute background polling `setInterval` in `App.jsx` to trigger `syncUser()` so that SuperAdmin feature access changes take effect without requiring manual logouts. Fixed Free plan inclusion in Superadmin `PlansAndLimits.jsx` to allow custom access overrides.
Synchronized frontend audit table with new backend password operations (`PASSWORD_RESET`, `PASSWORD_CHANGED`, etc.). Ensuring security events are visible in the platform-wide event auditing log.
